kind: coordinator visual observation; separate from primary and independent reviewer
observations: The 1440px light view preserves the Tabler surface, field hierarchy and separated notification action; the toast overlaps upper-right utility actions.
The 390px lower-page error view contains the source toast within the viewport and leaves the lower Cancel and Save controls visible. It occludes some content above those controls until dismissal.
The 390px dark Chinese invalid view visibly associates a red outlined display-name field with a readable Chinese error. The dark notification retains its header and close affordance.
scope: Three original static screenshots were actually opened. No additional interaction, keyboard behavior, persistence, screen-reader response or natural-time motion was verified by these view calls.
disposition: Retain the composition and occlusion observations for later scoped evaluation. This is not the independent product acceptance and does not approve final-runtime G products.
